# Book of the Dead of Ani — questions for the owner

- 2026-11-16 · Spell 125 · RESOLVED the same day: the owner wants the address to the gods (Budge's Appendix, pp. 203–212, not on Ani's papyrus) added as a marked supplement. It is part ani-125-address, second in the order. The longer introduction in the Appendix of pp. 193–197 was not asked for and stays out.
- 2026-11-16 · voice · The declarations' voice needed your approval of every take. Decided meanwhile: new parts publish without audio, with the pronunciation line filled in, until you choose a voice that reads the same way every time.
- 2026-11-16 · order in the library · Parts are listed in papyrus order (by Budge's page), so the introduction to Spell 125 appears before the declarations and the rubric after them, and the earlier plates above them as they are published.
- 2026-11-18 · lemma keys for homographs · pr (participle of pri in the declarations vs pr "house"), n (negation vs preposition "to"), ir ("do" vs the particle), sš ("scribe" vs a doubtful verb "pass") each sit under one glossary key, the second word added as "a second word of the same spelling". Decided meanwhile: keep this; the clean fix would be re-keying the declarations' participle to `pri` and giving homographs numbered keys — your call.
- 2026-11-18 · `say` vowel rule · some forms skip the e between consonants (hetepkwi, rekhtu, imten), as the published declarations do in places (henbet, khenty). Decided meanwhile: left as drafted; a single ruling for the whole work would let a later firing normalise all parts.
- 2026-11-18 · sign glossary · 81 new Egyptian sign entries were written without a sign list to hand (values from the Gardiner list as remembered); 13 were corrected by the run lead. Worth a look by you or a later check against a sign list.
- 2026-11-18 · ani-125-address · homograph keys again: this part broadened 15 known keys with "a second word of the same spelling" (hrw "day", tꜣ "land", st the dependent pronoun, sḫt "field", rd "grow", ḥmt the place Hemet, qrt a door part, ꜥꜣ "donkey"/"door"…), and per-occurrence glosses carry the right sense. Decided meanwhile: same practice as the introduction; numbered homograph keys would be cleaner — your call (see the 2026-11-18 entry above).
- 2026-11-18 · sign glossary · 80 more Egyptian sign entries (for ani-125-address) were written by Sonnet from memory and corrected by the run lead without a sign list to hand; a few remain vague (V39 "tie (uncertain)", M6, Aa21). Worth a check against a sign list.
- 2026-11-19 · ani-hymn-to-ra · parts.json cites the hymn as Budge pp. 1–4; the established text runs to p. 5 l. 28. Decided meanwhile: published with the established range; the cite field was left as it was.
- 2026-11-19 · sign glossary · 25 more Egyptian sign entries (for ani-hymn-to-ra) were written by the run lead from memory of the Gardiner list, no sign list to hand; F9 (given as pḥ, in pḥty), R7, X6 are the least sure. Worth a check against a sign list.
- 2026-11-19 · ani-hymn-to-osiris · parts.json cites the hymn as Budge pp. 8–10; the established text runs to p. 11 l. 20. Decided meanwhile: established with the real range; the cite field left as it was (as for the hymn to Ra).
